tiktok.author: godzillaenlacasa
tiktok.body: Launching on Hacker News? Count your title first. Hacker News caps titles at 80 characters. Ours was 92. My AI Growth agent caught it and cut it to 79, and also flagged a line that overstated what our scanner does. HN would have caught that in about four seconds, so it got rewritten too. (HN then told us new accounts can't post a Show HN yet.) Then my AI CEO Angie rewrote the buy button: it now names your worst problem and counts the rest. Day 10 of building ShipLatch in public with an AI team. Free security scans for vibe-coded apps: shiplatch.com #buildinpublic #vibecoding #appsecurity
